impact: A strong finish to a whipsaw week supports MU, DRAM, NBIS and the wider AI book into December, though the Nasdaq still had a brutal November and rate-hike and tariff risks remain.
summary: In the shortened session, the Nasdaq Composite rose 2.31% to 24,129.50, the S&P 500 gained 1.6% to 7,297.49 and the Dow added 591.99 points (1.18%) to 50,774.94, per CNBC, as AI and chip stocks rebounded. Gains re-widened into the 1 p.m. ET close after narrowing mid-morning. CNBC said the Dow closed out its best week since 2022.
title: Nasdaq closes up 2.3%, S&P 1.6% on Black Friday; Dow's best week since 2022
